name: learn-skills
description: Agent skills that package evidence-backed pedagogical methodologies as workflows for learning code and topics with Codex.

interface.longDescription: Learn Skills packages evidence-backed teaching workflows for Codex: explain code in your own words, test recall, connect concepts to prior knowledge, generate exercises, notes, and flashcards, and assess understanding without false numeric scores.
defaultPrompt: Use $start-learn to choose the right learning workflow.
Use $explain-and-check to verify my understanding of this file.
Use $learn-by-doing to create practice exercises for this topic.
